_comment: Organisations TrustLens recognises. NEVER add customer-care phone numbers here: we tell people to use the number printed on their card/bill/passbook or the official app. officialSmsHeaders use '*' for the 2-letter operator prefix (VM-, AD-, JX- ...). Double-check domains/headers before the demo.

orgs.name: State Bank of India (SBI)
verifySteps: Open the YONO SBI app yourself (not from a link) and check for any alert.
KYC is updated only inside the official app, on onlinesbi.sbi typed by you, or at your branch.
Call the customer-care number printed on your passbook or the back of your debit card.
SBI never asks for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords over SMS, call, email or WhatsApp.

orgs.name: HDFC Bank
verifySteps: Open the HDFC Bank app or NetBanking by typing hdfcbank.com yourself.
Call the number printed on the back of your HDFC card or in your passbook.
HDFC Bank never asks for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords.

orgs.name: ICICI Bank
verifySteps: Check your account in the iMobile Pay app opened by you.
Call the number printed on your ICICI card or passbook.
ICICI Bank never asks for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords.

orgs.name: Axis Bank
verifySteps: Check alerts inside the official Axis Bank app opened by you.
Call the number printed on your Axis card or passbook.
Axis Bank never asks for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords.

orgs.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
verifySteps: Check inside the official Kotak app opened by you.
Call the number printed on your Kotak card or passbook.
Kotak never asks for OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords.

orgs.name: BESCOM (Bangalore Electricity)
verifySteps: Check your bill in the BESCOM Mithra app or on the official BESCOM website, typed in yourself.
Call the helpline printed on your paper electricity bill — not a number from the SMS.
BESCOM does not cut power at night because of an SMS from a personal mobile number.
Pay only through the official app, website or a BESCOM counter.

orgs.name: India Post
verifySteps: Track the article yourself on indiapost.gov.in using the tracking number on your receipt.
India Post does not ask for small 'redelivery' or 'address update' fees through SMS links.
Visit your nearest post office if you are unsure.

orgs.name: Blue Dart
orgs.officialApp: Blue Dart website (track by AWB number)
verifySteps: Track your parcel on bluedart.com using the waybill number from the seller's app.
Couriers do not ask for UPI payments or OTPs to 'release' a parcel.
Check the order inside the shopping app you bought from.

orgs.name: Delhivery
verifySteps: Track the shipment on delhivery.com or in the shopping app you ordered from.
Couriers do not ask for extra fees through SMS links.
Never share an OTP with a delivery agent unless you are physically receiving the parcel.

orgs.name: Amazon
verifySteps: Open the Amazon app yourself and check 'Your Orders'.
Amazon does not hire through WhatsApp/Telegram or ask for registration fees.
Contact Amazon only through 'Customer Service' inside the app.

orgs.name: Flipkart
verifySteps: Open the Flipkart app yourself and check 'My Orders'.
Use 'Help Centre' inside the app — not numbers from messages or search results.
Flipkart does not run lucky draws that need you to pay a fee.

orgs.name: Paytm
verifySteps: Open the Paytm app yourself and check notifications.
KYC for wallets is done only inside the app — never via a link or a call.
Never enter your UPI PIN to 'receive' money.

orgs.name: PhonePe
verifySteps: Open the PhonePe app yourself and check 'History'.
A UPI PIN is only ever needed to SEND money, never to receive it.
Use 'Help' inside the app for support.

orgs.name: Google Pay
verifySteps: Open Google Pay yourself and check the transaction history.
A UPI PIN is only needed to SEND money, never to receive it.
Decline collect requests from people you don't know.

orgs.name: NPCI / UPI
orgs.officialApp: Your bank's UPI app (BHIM, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm …)
verifySteps: Entering your UPI PIN always SENDS money — you never need it to receive money.
Scanning a QR code also only sends money. 'Scan to receive' is always a scam.
Reject unknown 'collect' requests inside your UPI app.

orgs.name: Income Tax Department
verifySteps: Log in yourself at incometax.gov.in to see refund status — it is never 'released' via a link.
The department never asks for card details, OTP or a fee to process a refund.
Refunds go straight to your pre-validated bank account.

orgs.name: UIDAI (Aadhaar)
verifySteps: Update Aadhaar only at myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in (typed by you) or an Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
UIDAI never asks for your Aadhaar OTP over a call or message.
Lock your biometrics in the mAadhaar app if you think your number was misused.

orgs.name: Police / CBI / Cyber Crime
verifySteps: 'Digital arrest' does not exist. Police, CBI, customs or TRAI never arrest anyone over a video call or message.
Hang up. Do not stay on a call, do not install any app they ask for, do not move money to 'verify' it.
Talk to family, then visit your local police station in person or call 1930 if you lost money.

orgs.name: Jio
verifySteps: Check your plan and KYC inside the MyJio app opened by you.
Jio does not block SIMs over SMS for 'KYC pending' and never asks you to call a mobile number.
Visit a Jio store with ID if you really need to update details.

orgs.name: Airtel
verifySteps: Check your account in the Airtel Thanks app opened by you.
Airtel never asks for OTPs or remote-access apps to 'fix KYC'.
Visit an Airtel store with ID if you really need to update details.

orgs.name: Job / recruitment offer
verifySteps: Real employers never charge a registration, training or 'refundable' joining fee.
Find the job on the company's official careers page yourself — not via WhatsApp/Telegram links.
Don't share Aadhaar, PAN or bank details before you have a verified written offer.
